technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish with price above 50/200 EMAs and SMA, but short-term momentum is weak with price below intermediate moving averages, no rising RSI, and weak ADX; volume spike and squeeze positive context provide some support but lack of directional confirmation limits entry probability.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 91 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with slight bullish bias (44.9% bullish); insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (95.2) indicates extreme market stress, and FOMC event just occurred; earnings in 91 days provides buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure is bullish (price above 50/200 EMAs, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (70.8252) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 95.2, post-FOMC volatility), weak short-term momentum (price below EMA-9/21, flat RSI, weak ADX), zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, high earnings risk in 91 days), and lack of directional volume confirmation make this a high-risk entry in an unfavourable environment.
